clauses.clause: The bay stays open; firefighter repeats "Get in!"; infected stay live until entry.
clauses.note: High/low physical keyboard entry: three Get in text calls ticks 6408, 6648, 6888; minimum living infected 50/25 while approaching; gate stays open until tick 7107, when objective completes and gate state changes to closed; corgi signed inside depth 1.05 m each. But the default-follow physical-inside, entry-end and shutter-settled frames on both tiers show the station facade as large dark cutaway triangles and no visible shutter, so its requested closure is not player-visible. Repro: reach fire station, wait 8 s near bay, enter via WASD and observe follow camera on entry and 1 s later. Damage protection throughout and native input before final approach; no teleport or objective skip; no audio claim.
